title: I Know Whom I Have Believed

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: and am per[A]suaded that His is [D]able

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [D]But "I know whom [G]I have believed, and am [D]persuaded that His is able
[G]To keep that [D]which I've committed Unto [A]Him against that day."

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [D]I know not how [G]this saving faith To [D]me He did impart,
[G]Nor how believing [D]in His word Wrought [A]peace within my heart.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [D]I know not [G]how the Spirit moves, [D]Convincing men of sin,
[G]Revealing Jesus through [D]the word, Creating [A]faith in Him.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [D]I know not when [G]my Lord may come, [D]At night or noonday fair,
[G]Nor if I walk [D]the vale with Him, Or [A]meet Him in the air.
